QuestInfo.name: An Arrangement from the Goddess.
QuestInfo.0: The Status of Goddess that has been silent has something to say.
QuestInfo.1:
The goddess said she will give a new power to those that have reached the highest level that is available as a person.
Go to #p2030005# in #m200081400# and convey your resolve.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as you went to the statue and conveyed your resolve, the goddess gave you power that wasn't for your own benefit, but for everyone else around you.

0.0: I have waited for adventurers like you for a very long time. Countless battles...and even more encounters... You have experienced everything this world has to offer.
0.1: You have made a long journey and arrive at the highest level one can reach. I would like to become a stepping stone for you to overcome your limits.
0.2: Please come to me if you are ready to accept the new power.

no.0: Are you not ready yet? I'll be waiting here.

1.0: You're here. Does that mean you're ready to accept the new power?
1.1: This power isn't for your own benefit, but for everyone else around you... This is a blessing and a burden for you.

yes.0: Your presence will enrich the lives of everyone in this world. Please continue your journey towards greatness.
